$comment: The agent workforce roster (Alan 2026-11-25: "Build our agent workforce to take on all these new corporate tasks to keep everything flowing"). One row per agent: what it does, when it runs (Mountain time, Alan's), what runs it, its prompt, and how we know it worked. The Roster Keeper (ROSTER-KEEPER-PROMPT.md) reads this file twice a day, matches each row to its scheduled task, workflow run or heartbeat, and republishes the status page. Change a row by PR. runner.kind: task = a project scheduled task (trig_ id), workflow = a GitHub Actions workflow in this repo (file name), app = a Railway cron or app code in AIE-Solutions/Marketplace, external = a paid tool outside our code. cadenceHours = longest normal gap between runs; a row quiet for 1.5x that is flagged. heartbeat = the X-Agent-Name it sends to POST /api/agent/heartbeat at the end of a run (null = no heartbeat; health comes from the runner).
hardLimits: No spend, no investor contact, no deleting data or removing listings, no Stripe or console changes, no subscription cancellations, no bans (Alan's call). Copy follows MESSAGING.md. Never Alan's personal name in anything users read. Every video ends on the end card.

agents.name: Roster Keeper
agents.does: Checks every agent on this roster ran when it should, rebuilds this status page, and routes any quiet or failing agent to its owner.
agents.health: Heartbeat roster-keeper; the page's Updated time

agents.name: Platform Ops
agents.does: Reads the daily Ops and Growth digests, safety and moderation signals, AI budget and checkout alerts, and routes each problem to its owner.

agents.name: Ops Sweep
agents.does: Checks production health, red CI and yesterday's merges, and fixes up to 3 bugs a run with tests.
agents.health: Ops log issue comment; heartbeat ops-sweep

agents.name: Guard
agents.does: Checks every send and the next 48 hours of queued posts against the caps and copy rules, and pauses or fixes anything off-rule through its owner.

agents.name: Optimizer
agents.does: Scores every agent each week, rewrites up to 3 agent prompts inside the guardrails, and reverts changes that made things worse.

agents.name: App crons
agents.does: Boost expiry, saved-search alerts, activation and seller nudges, lifecycle emails, scheduled admin messages and the daily digests, inside the app.
agents.health: OpsDigest attention list and Railway logs, read by Platform Ops

agents.name: Owner alerts
agents.does: Emails Alan and rings the admin bell on new subscriptions, cancels, ended plans and failed payments; feeds the admin Overview.
agents.health: GET /api/agent/activity, read daily by Billing Watch

agents.name: Growth Lead
agents.does: Reads users, storefronts and app numbers, picks the biggest lever toward 10,000 users and 500 storefronts, and hands it to its owner.

agents.name: Dealer Loader
agents.does: Finds dealers and fleets, sends storefront claim notes and day-4 follow-ups at a safe pace.

agents.name: Funnel Engineer
agents.does: Ships one sign-up or storefront funnel fix per run from FUNNEL-BACKLOG.md and merges it when green.
agents.health: Item marked done in FUNNEL-BACKLOG.md; heartbeat funnel-engineer

agents.name: Outreach email sender
agents.does: Sends the queued dealer outreach emails in small batches with bounce and send caps.
agents.schedule: Weekdays every 30 min, 8 am to 3 pm

agents.name: Investor docs refresh
agents.does: Updates the numbers in our own investor one-pager, drafts and deck. Never contacts an investor.

agents.name: Reply Handler
agents.does: Answers dealer and seller replies, sends checkout follow-ups and storefront welcomes, and runs the daily posting-rules review.

agents.name: Storefront Care
agents.does: For every live or gifted storefront: checks its page and map pin, sends the exact-address and setup nudge, and queues its social welcome post so the promise in the welcome is kept.

agents.name: Comment replies
agents.does: Replies once to each new real comment on YouTube, Instagram and Facebook as the business, and logs leads.
agents.health: COMMENT-LOG.md and the day's DIGEST file

agents.name: Comment inbox
agents.does: Pulls new Instagram and Facebook comments into comments/inbox.json and posts queued replies.

agents.name: Site chat helper watch
agents.does: Reads the week's chats with the site helper, lists what sellers asked and what it got wrong, and runs its tests.
agents.health: Scheduled task run; the weekly report section in growth-loop/HELPER-QUESTIONS.md

agents.name: Site chat helper health check
agents.does: Runs the site chat helper's tests and checks the help pages load, so a broken helper is caught within a week.

agents.name: Billing Watch
agents.does: Reads new subscriptions, trials, cancels and failed payments; checks every founding storefront trial has its $29 discount before the first charge; never changes Stripe.

agents.name: Founding discount check (Quiet Village)
agents.does: One-off: confirms the first paying storefront's founding discount is on before its Dec 24 charge.

agents.name: Reels and Stories poster
agents.does: Posts our Reels and Stories to Instagram and Facebook in 10 daily slots, seller Reels in the daytime slots and listing Reels at night, plus one seller still image a day on the feed; skips clips without the end card.

agents.name: TikTok poster
agents.does: Posts 2 of our videos a day to TikTok, never within 75 minutes of the last one.

agents.name: YouTube Shorts poster
agents.does: Posts a Short at 9:00 am and 3:00 pm through Buffer, from the queue.

agents.name: YouTube and LinkedIn upload slots
agents.does: Uploads the week's long videos and LinkedIn posts from WEEKLY-BATCH.md through Zapier when each slot comes due.

agents.name: Just listed posts
agents.does: Turns new live listings into Instagram and Facebook posts, plus storefront welcome posts, after the daily review.

agents.name: Just listed card review
agents.does: Safety gate: approves or rejects each pending Just listed card (no faces, names, plates or phone numbers).

agents.name: Listing Reels review
agents.does: Safety gate for listing Reels: checks every photo before a listing Reel can post.

agents.name: LIST IT FREE Story
agents.does: Posts the daily LIST IT FREE Instagram Story and confirms it is live.

agents.name: HeyCatch (paid tool)
agents.does: Posts POV shorts 3 times a day and one blog article a day. Runs until Studio is proven and Alan decides.

agents.name: Motion Shorts maker
agents.does: Makes 7 new seller and storefront Shorts each run from real listings and the backlog, every one through the audits and ending on the end card.
agents.schedule: Mon 6:41 am, Wed 7:52 am, Fri 7:37 am

agents.name: End card check
agents.does: Counts library clips still missing the end card (the posters skip them) and asks Motion to fix them when the postable pool runs low.
agents.schedule: With the Roster Keeper, twice daily
agents.health: End card line on this page

agents.name: Monday posting batch
agents.does: Plans the week: orders clips by results, writes the YouTube and LinkedIn rows, sends Motion the trend brief.

agents.name: Weekly trending-sound Short
agents.does: Picks one Short a week for Alan to post from his phone with a trending sound.

agents.name: Listening list
agents.does: Finds Reddit and forum threads where people ask about selling or buying used equipment.

agents.name: Monday YouTube report
agents.does: Emails the weekly channel report, replies to comments and feeds the scorecard.

agents.name: Metrics scorecard
agents.does: Rebuilds metrics/SCORECARD.md and the Reels boost ranking from the latest numbers.

agents.name: Profile check
agents.does: Checks the Facebook and Instagram profiles still show the right bio, links and name.

agents.name: Studio blog writer
agents.does: Writes and publishes up to two articles a day (one specific, one broad) on our own blog through the agent blog API, and copies HeyCatch's articles into our store, in place of HeyCatch's and Soro's articles.
agents.schedule: Twice a day, 7:21 am and 2:21 pm Central (one article per lane per day)

agents.name: Studio POV shorts
agents.does: Builds our own 7.5 second POV shorts from approved listing photos, with the end card, up to 5 a day; each waits in the Studio deck (yardswaps.com/admin/studio) for approve / skip, then goes to the Reels, TikTok and Shorts posters.

agents.name: Studio deck sync
agents.does: Copies the approve / skip / edit decisions from yardswaps.com/admin/studio into reels/library.json, so skipped Studio clips never post, approved ones join the rotation, and clips nobody reviews post after a day. The morning run also scores account health per platform (studio/HEALTH.md), which the posters check before each post.
agents.schedule: Three times a day, 7:35 am, 11:35 am and 3:35 pm Mountain

agents.name: Studio audit
agents.does: Scores the site out of 100 every week (SEO and GEO in 4 pillars, landing pages against MESSAGING.md and 2 competitors, the App Store and Google Play listings), saves it to studio/audits with the change since last week, and sends the top fixes with copy-paste prompts to the coordinator to route.

agents.name: Studio analytics
agents.does: Our own replacement for HeyCatch's site analytics and account audits.

agents.name: Studio connector (Claude)
agents.does: Lets Claude use the blog writer and the Studio deck for one brand at a time (YardSwaps, Arkeous, Dacnus), as a custom connector. The YardSwaps side only calls the blog and deck APIs with its own narrow token; it never posts or renders.

runner.ref: studio-connector (Railway project Studio), Marketplace services/studio-connector, PR #547

agents.name: Fresh items (weekly rotation)
agents.does: Makes up to six new seller Reels and two seller stills from real listings not shown in two weeks, across item types; rests the seller Reels shown most; lines up next week's seller Stories (Alan 11-26: rotate the items we show).
agents.health: Weekly PR with new reels/library.json seller rows and motion/audit/<date>/ sheets

retired.name: Comment sweep (Wed, Fri, Sun)
retired.why: Replaced by the daily Comment replies at the same time; running both risks double replies. Paused 2026-11-25.

retired.name: Weekly video pickup (Oct)
retired.why: October-era job that wiped the media repo after each push; the Monday posting batch replaced it. Paused 2026-11-25.
